placeArmAt: Click a spot on the image to place the anchor of part {{n}}
placeArmB: Click a spot on the image to place the number badge of part {{n}}
placeNew: Click a spot on the image to add a part
hintArmAt: Click on the image to place the anchor of part {{n}}.
hintArmB: Click on the image to place the number badge of part {{n}}.
hintNew: Click on the image to add a part (the anchor goes where you click, the number badge to its upper left; you can move them later).
bayOn: On (a bay that's off is still drawn in the cargo bay, it just can't be opened)
eyebrow: Small English text · after PAYLOAD in the title bar
label: Category name
partsHint: Part positions and numbers come with the sheet; fill in your own names and specs, and check "Hidden" for the ones you don't need.
name: Name
uploadField: Upload image · white line art on a transparent background works best (it's drawn on the dark cargo bay)
extraHead: Unnumbered items in the parts list
telemetry: Connect this server's live telemetry (temperature, load, memory)
devicePosts: Posts about it · post IDs, comma-separated
records: Posts related to this bay · post IDs, comma-separated
customHint: To light up a whole part on hover, or draw your own network lines and signal rings, put a sheet pack in custom/setup/ (see the README there). After a rebuild it shows up in the "Sheet" menu.
baseOn: On (the satellite on the distant orbit; when off it's still drawn, it just can't be opened)
specsHead: Specs · matched in order to the numbers on the satellite, up to 7
